results.title: Patrick Mahomes finally announces return date after heartbreaking Chiefs decision against Buccaneers
results.description: Patrick Mahomes has revealed his return plans after being held out of the Chiefs’ preseason matchup against the Buccaneers. Despite wanting to play, Kansas City chose caution as he continues recovering from last December’s ACL and LCL injuries. Mahomes says he feels increasingly athletic and hopes to play next week, but Andy Reid and the medical team will make the final call. For now, Mahomes remains confident about starting Week 1.
